usage.callShape: POST https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/compute/batch with JSON body {jobs:[{type,...}]} where type is one of text-inference, image-generation, video-generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, embeddings
quirks: Charge-then-fail: gateway returns HTTP 200 with valid batch accounting (batch_id, results[], cost breakdown) but the actual job FAILS at the upstream 'Chutes' inference backend, which returns a 404 HTML page instead of a result. You pay $0.05/call and get no usable output.

Empty inputSchema in registry. The job 'type' field is REQUIRED; omitting it 400s with hint listing valid types: text-inference, image-generation, video-generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, embeddings.

text-inference job failed even with valid {type, messages} shape; likely also needs a 'model' field, but the upstream backend route is itself dead (404), so supplying a model would not have produced a working result.
Charged twice during QA ($0.10 total): first $0.05 on the type-missing 400, second $0.05 on the 200-but-job-failed call. Payment is taken before the job outcome is known.
